The '''Melida''' were a faction of people on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Governed by the [[Melida Council]], they were at war with the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] until [[the Young]] ended the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]].
